name: memory_prepare_turn
description: Retrieve relevant memory context for the current user message. Call this at the START of every turn, before reading the user's message. Returns a context block string to prepend to your working context. On build/fix/navigate-shaped messages, also appends a one-line nudge toward minigraf_query-based code-graph navigation when the repo has an ingested graph.

user_message.description: The user's message for this turn
